description.zh-TW: 把來源轉成有結構、可展示的簡報。可搭配 44 種視覺主題與 3 種年齡層。
description.en: Turn sources into structured presentation decks with 44 visual themes and 3 audience profiles.

workflows.starter: Use only the selected sources. Create a clear slide deck for {{audience}} about {{focus}}. Keep every claim grounded in the sources. Use one main idea per slide, strong hierarchy, and concise wording.

description.zh-TW: 聚焦 Deep Dive、Brief、Critique 或 Debate 等音訊方向。
description.en: Focus an audio generation such as Deep Dive, Brief, Critique, or Debate.

workflows.starter: Use only the selected sources. Focus the audio overview on {{focus}} for {{audience}}. Explain the most important connections in plain language, distinguish source facts from interpretation, and avoid adding unsupported examples.

description.zh-TW: 為 Explainer 或 Brief 影片指定受眾、重點與敘事節奏。
description.en: Set audience, focus, and pacing for Explainer or Brief video overviews.

workflows.starter: Use only the selected sources. Create a visual explainer focused on {{focus}} for {{audience}}. Build a beginning-middle-end structure, visualize relationships rather than decorating them, and never invent scenes or claims not supported by the sources.

description.zh-TW: 把來源濃縮成單頁視覺摘要，適合比較、流程與重點數據。
description.en: Compress sources into a one-page visual summary for comparisons, processes, or key data.

workflows.starter: Use only the selected sources. Create an infographic about {{focus}} for {{audience}}. Prioritize 3–5 key takeaways, clear relationships, readable labels, and source-faithful numbers. Do not invent statistics, icons with misleading meaning, or unsupported comparisons.

description.zh-TW: 做理解、應用、情境題，避免只考死背。
description.en: Generate comprehension, application, and scenario questions instead of rote recall only.

workflows.starter: Use only the selected sources. Create a {{difficulty}} quiz for {{audience}} focused on {{focus}}. Mix recall with application and scenario-based questions. Make distractors plausible but source-consistent, and explain each answer from the source material.

description.zh-TW: 把關鍵概念拆成短題面與精準答案。
description.en: Break key concepts into short fronts and precise source-grounded answers.

workflows.starter: Use only the selected sources. Create flashcards for {{audience}} on {{focus}}. Keep each card front short and specific. Put one concept per card, use concise answers, and preserve exact source terminology where it matters.

description.zh-TW: 產出 briefing、study guide、blog-style 或自訂報告。
description.en: Create briefings, study guides, blog-style outputs, or custom reports.

workflows.starter: Use only the selected sources. Write a structured report for {{audience}} about {{focus}}. Start with the main conclusion, organize evidence by theme, preserve important caveats, and make unsupported gaps explicit instead of filling them with outside knowledge.

description.zh-TW: 把來源整理成可比較、可匯出的欄列資料。
description.en: Extract sources into comparable, exportable rows and columns.

workflows.starter: Use only the selected sources. Build a data table focused on {{focus}} for {{audience}}. Choose columns that support comparison, keep one entity or finding per row, preserve units and dates exactly, and leave cells blank when the sources do not provide an answer.

description.zh-TW: 用來源限定、角色與回答格式建立可重複問答流程。
description.en: Create a reusable source-grounded chat workflow with role and response structure.

workflows.starter: Answer only from the selected sources. Act as a {{role}} helping {{audience}} understand {{focus}}. Cite the relevant source passages when possible. If the sources do not support an answer, say what is missing instead of guessing.

description.zh-TW: 心智圖本身由 Studio 生成；這裡提供生成前後的聚焦問句與檢查清單。
description.en: Mind maps are generated in Studio; this recipe helps you focus and review them before and after generation.

workflows.starter: Before generating a mind map, identify the 3–7 main themes in the selected sources about {{focus}} and list the most important relationships among them. After the map is generated, check whether any major source-supported relationship is missing or overstated.
